LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Command_Tip: Stop the selected pawns' current tasks and let them choose what to do next. Queued tasks remain queued.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Settings_ShowGizmo_Tip: Show the Interrupt Task button for controllable colonists, slaves, children, and overseen colony mechs. Disabling this renders this mod useless.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Settings_ConfirmForced: Show Confirm Dialog when interrupting forced tasks
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Settings_ConfirmForced_Tip: When interrupting multiple pawns at once, ask before interrupting a task you forced a pawn to perform.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Settings_Goofy_Tip: Renames the command to Sneeze, rewrites every message it shows, and adds a puff of air and a sound when a task stops. Purely cosmetic: exactly the same tasks can be interrupted either way.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_ConfirmForced: At least one of the {0} selected pawns is doing work you forced. Interrupt the safe tasks anyway?
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Reason_NotControlled: This pawn is not under direct player control.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Reason_Incapacitated: Incapacitated pawns cannot have their task interrupted.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Reason_Drafted: Undraft the pawn before interrupting a civilian task.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Reason_Organized: This pawn is taking part in an organized activity.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Reason_GameProtected: RimWorld or another mod has marked this task uninterruptible.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Reason_MustComplete: This task must finish before another can begin.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Reason_Cooldown: Wait a moment before interrupting another task.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Goofy_Command_Tip: Interrupt task? Nawwwwwwwwww. Sneeze? Yeahhhhh.\n\nStops whatever the selected pawns are doing. Queued tasks stay queued. Nobody actually catches anything.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Goofy_ConfirmForced: At least one of the {0} selected pawns is doing work you personally ordered. Sneeze on the safe ones anyway?
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Goofy_Reason_NotControlled: Not your pawn, not your sneeze.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Goofy_Reason_MentalState: Already having a moment. No sneeze required.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Goofy_Reason_Drafted: Undraft first. Sneezing while armed is rude.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Goofy_Reason_Organized: Busy being social. Sneezing would be a whole thing.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Goofy_Reason_GameProtected: The game says no sneezing here.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Goofy_Reason_MustComplete: Finish this bit first, then sneeze.
LanguageData.TaskInterrupt_Goofy_Reason_Ritual: You do not sneeze during the ritual.
